claims: The Artemis II mission is scheduled to launch as early as April 1, 2026.
Artemis II marks the first crewed flight test of the SLS rocket and Orion spacecraft around the Moon.
The scheduled launch time for Artemis II is 6:24 p.m. ET on April 1, 2026.
Fueling operations coverage for Artemis II begins at 7:45 a.m. ET on April 1, 2026.
The primary stream for the Artemis II launch is on NASA+ and the NASA YouTube channel.
The primary stream for the Artemis II launch provides 24/7 coverage of operations.
Live coverage of the Artemis II launch is available on X (formerly Twitter).
Live coverage of the Artemis II launch is available on Facebook.
Live coverage of the Artemis II launch is available on Twitch.
CBS News will provide live coverage of the Artemis II launch.
FOX Weather will provide live coverage of the Artemis II launch.
The European Space Agency will stream the Artemis II event.
The Artemis II mission is a 10-day mission.
The Artemis II mission will test the systems necessary for long-term human exploration of the Moon and Mars.
